26C what-to-test checklist

A starting point for checking the 26C quarterly update: in your test environment before it reaches production, or in production if you're already on it. Tick items as you go (ticks are not saved).

Impact on upgrade is our editorial rating of how much a change affects existing users and testing; Oracle scale is Oracle's own rating. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

  • 9 HCM Redwood default switches and other HCM notices for 26D
  • 9 baseline regression checks, plus typical 26D test and production dates by cohort

HCM: pages switching to Redwood in 26C (5)

Oracle announces these HCM changes in its HCM What's New documents as Redwood default switches (and a few end-of-support, migration or removal notices), not as opt-in expirations. They are not on Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list and are not part of the former opt-ins counts on this site. 9 more are already announced for 26D. All HCM pages switching to Redwood →

Global HRSwitches to Redwood by defaultFrom 26CRevert: Profile option can be set back to No

Five workforce structures pages switch to Redwood by default from 26C.

Pages affected: Grades, Grade Rates, Legal Entity HCM Information, Legal Reporting Unit HCM Information, Reporting Establishments

Profile options named on Oracle's page: ORA_PER_GRADES_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_PER_GRADE_RATES_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_PER_LEGAL_ENTITY_HCM_INFO_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_PER_LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_HCM_INFO_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_PER_REPORTING_ESTABLISHMENTS_REDWOOD_ENABLED

Oracle source

BenefitsSwitches to Redwood by defaultFrom 26CRevert: None stated on this page

Benefits self-service and administration pages default to Redwood from 26C; Oracle delivers new Benefits enhancements in Redwood only.

Pages affected: Benefits Employee Self-Service, Benefits Administration

Oracle source

Payroll (UK)Switches to Redwood by defaultFrom 26CRevert: Profile option can be set back to No

The UK Pension Enrollment and New Starter Declaration self-service pages switch to Redwood by default from 26C.

Pages affected: Pension Enrollment, New Starter Declaration

Profile options named on Oracle's page: ORA_HRX_GB_VBCS_ESS_BP, ORA_HRX_GB_VBCS_ESS_NSD

Oracle source

LearningMigrationFrom 26CRevert: None stated

Oracle stops supporting the predictive-AI Suggested Career feature from 26C and replaces it with generative-AI career role suggestions.

Pages affected: Career role suggestions (Grow, Opportunity Marketplace)

Oracle's title: “Mandatory migration to enhanced career role suggestions using generative AI”

Oracle source

RecruitingEnd of supportFrom 26CRevert: None stated

Oracle retires the Hybrid skill-suggestion logic after 26B; requisitions not on the Redwood creation flow and details page no longer show suggested skills.

Pages affected: Suggested Skills in job requisitions

Oracle source
